text_en: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of the Lord , “Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites, to fight against them? ”
text_cn: 若苏厄死后，以色列子民询问上主说：“我们中谁应首先上去攻打客纳罕人？”

text_en: The Lord said, “Judah shall go up. I hereby give the land into his hand. ”
text_cn: 上主说：“犹大先上去。看，我已将那地交在他手中。”

text_en: Judah said to his brother Simeon, “Come up with me into the territory allotted to me, that we may fight against the Canaanites; then I too will go with you into the territory allotted to you. ” So Simeon went with him.
text_cn: 犹大遂对自己的兄弟西默盎说：“请你同我到我拈（niān）阄（jiū）所得的地方去，与客纳罕人作战，日后我也同你到你拈阄所得的地方去。”西默盎就同他去了。

text_en: Then Judah went up and the Lord gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand; and they defeated ten thousand of them at Bezek.
text_cn: 犹大上去，上主把客纳罕人和培黎齐人交在他们手中，他们在贝则克击杀了一万人。

text_en: They came upon Adoni-bezek at Bezek, and fought against him, and defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
text_cn: 他们在贝则克又遇上了阿多尼贝则克，与他交战，击败了客纳罕人和培黎齐人。

text_en: Adoni-bezek fled; but they pursued him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
text_cn: 阿多尼贝则克逃走，他们在后面追赶，捉住他，割去了他手脚的拇指。

text_en: Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off used to pick up scraps under my table; as I have done, so God has paid me back. ” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
text_cn: 阿多尼贝则克说：“七十位王子被割去了手脚的拇指，在我桌下拾取零碎食物；天主照我所行的报复了我。”他们将他带到耶路撒冷，他就死在那里。

text_en: Then the people of Judah fought against Jerusalem and took it. They put it to the sword and set the city on fire.
text_cn: 犹大子孙攻打了耶路撒冷，将城占领，用利剑杀了城中的居民，放火烧了城。

text_en: Afterward the people of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, in the Negeb, and in the lowland.
text_cn: 此后，犹大子孙下去与住在山地、南方和平原的客纳罕人作战。

text_en: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron (the name of Hebron was formerly Kiriath-arba); and they defeated Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.
text_cn: 犹大又去攻打住在赫贝龙的客纳罕人，──赫贝龙以前名叫克黎雅特阿尔巴，──击败了舍瑟、阿希曼和塔耳买。

text_en: From there they went against the inhabitants of Debir (the name of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher).
text_cn: 他们从那里又去攻打住在德彼尔的居民，──德彼尔以前名叫克黎雅特色费尔。

text_en: Then Caleb said, “Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and takes it, I will give him my daughter Achsah as wife. ”
text_cn: 那时加肋布说：“谁能攻打克黎雅特色费尔，将城拿下，我就将我的女儿阿革撒嫁给他为妻。”

text_en: And Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; and he gave him his daughter Achsah as wife.
text_cn: 加肋布的弟弟刻纳次的儿子敖特尼耳夺取了那城，加肋布遂把自己的女儿阿革撒嫁给他为妻。

text_en: When she came to him, she urged him to ask her father for a field. As she dismounted from her donkey, Caleb said to her, “What do you wish? ”
text_cn: 当她过门的时候，丈夫劝她向父亲要一块田地，她一下驴，加肋布便问她说：“你要什么？”

text_en: She said to him, “Give me a present; since you have set me in the land of the Negeb, give me also Gulloth-mayim. ” So Caleb gave her Upper Gulloth and Lower Gulloth.
text_cn: 她答说：“请你给我一件礼物，因为你既把我安置于南方旱地，求你也将水泉给我！”加肋布遂把上泉和下泉给了她。

text_en: The descendants of Hobab the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up with the people of Judah from the city of palms into the wilderness of Judah, which lies in the Negeb near Arad. Then they went and settled with the Amalekites.
text_cn: 梅瑟的姻亲刻尼的子孙从棕树城上来，同犹大子孙一同往阿辣得南方的犹大旷野去，与那里的百姓住在一起。

text_en: Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they defeated the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and devoted it to destruction. So the city was called Hormah.
text_cn: 以后犹大和他兄弟西默盎又起程，击败了住在责法特的客纳罕人，将城完全毁灭，故称这城为曷尔玛。

text_en: Judah took Gaza with its territory, Ashkelon with its territory, and Ekron with its territory.
text_cn: 犹大却未能夺取迦萨及其四境，阿市刻隆及其四境，厄刻龙及其四境。

text_en: The Lord was with Judah, and he took possession of the hill country, but could not drive out the inhabitants of the plain, because they had chariots of iron.
text_cn: 上主与犹大同在，因此，他占据了山地，但不能赶走平原的居民，因为他们有铁甲车。

text_en: Hebron was given to Caleb, as Moses had said; and he drove out from it the three sons of Anak.
text_cn: 按照梅瑟吩咐的，他们把赫贝龙给了加肋布，因为他由那里铲除了阿纳克的三支后裔。

text_en: But the Benjaminites did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have lived in Jerusalem among the Benjaminites to this day.
text_cn: 本雅明子孙没有逐出住在耶路撒冷的耶步斯人，因此耶步斯人与本雅明子孙，直到今日同住在耶路撒冷。

text_en: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel; and the Lord was with them.
text_cn: 若瑟家族也上去攻打贝特耳，上主与他们同在。

text_en: The house of Joseph sent out spies to Bethel (the name of the city was formerly Luz).
text_cn: 当若瑟家族差人去侦探贝特耳时，──这城昔名叫路次，──

text_en: When the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, “Show us the way into the city, and we will deal kindly with you. ”
text_cn: 侦探看见一个人从城里出来，就向他说：“请指给我们进城的路，我们必要恩待你。”

text_en: So he showed them the way into the city; and they put the city to the sword, but they let the man and all his family go.
text_cn: 那人就指给了他们进城的路；他们用刀屠杀了全城的居民，但把那人和他全家放走了。

text_en: So the man went to the land of the Hittites and built a city, and named it Luz; that is its name to this day.
text_cn: 那人到了赫特人的地方，建了一座城，起名叫路次，直到今日仍叫此名。

text_en: Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and its villages, or Taanach and its villages, or the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its villages, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; but the Canaanites continued to live in that land.
text_cn: 默纳协没有赶走贝特商及其属境的居民，塔纳客及其属境的居民，多尔及其属境的居民，依贝肋罕及其属境的居民，默基多及其属境的居民；客纳罕人依旧住在这些地方。

text_en: When Israel grew strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not in fact drive them out.
text_cn: 等到以色列强盛了，只能使客纳罕人服役，终未能把他们全部逐出。

text_en: And Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites lived among them in Gezer.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因也没有逐出住在革则尔的客纳罕人，所以客纳罕人仍在革则尔住在他们中间。

text_en: Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, or the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
text_cn: 则步隆也没有逐出克特龙的居民及纳哈罗耳的居民，客纳罕人仍住在他们中间，但应为他们服役。

text_en: Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Acco, or the inhabitants of Sidon, or of Ahlab, or of Achzib, or of Helbah, or of Aphik, or of Rehob;
text_cn: 阿协尔也没有把阿苛、漆冬、阿赫拉布、阿革齐布、赫耳巴、阿费克和勒曷布的居民逐出，

text_en: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
text_cn: 所以阿协尔人住在当地的居民客纳罕人中间，因为他们没有把他们逐出去。

text_en: Naphtali did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, or the inhabitants of Beth-anath, but lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became subject to forced labor for them.
text_cn: 纳斐塔里也没有把贝特舍默士的居民和贝特阿纳特的居民逐出，于是他们就住在当地的居民客纳罕人中间；但是贝特舍默士和贝特阿纳特的居民应为他们服役。

text_en: The Amorites pressed the Danites back into the hill country; they did not allow them to come down to the plain.
text_cn: 阿摩黎人强迫丹的子孙住在山上，不让他们下到平原。

text_en: The Amorites continued to live in Har-heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim, but the hand of the house of Joseph rested heavily on them, and they became subject to forced labor.
text_cn: 阿摩黎人依旧住在哈尔赫勒斯、阿雅隆和沙耳宾；但在若瑟家族势力强大之后，他们就成了服役的人。

text_en: The border of the Amorites ran from the ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela and upward.
text_cn: 厄东人的境界，是从阿刻辣宾山坡直到色拉以上地带。
